abstract: BACKGROUND: Men who remain azoospermic long after undergoing chemotherapy have generally been considered sterile. The authors report their experience with testicular sperm extraction (TESE) combined with intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) applied to azoospermic men who previously received chemotherapy for a variety of indications. METHODS: Among 231 cycles in 198 patients who underwent TESE-ICSI for nonobstructive azoospermia from 1995 to 2000, 20 TESE procedures in 17 patients who previously received chemotherapy were identified. All TESE procedures were performed with microsurgical control under local anesthesia with sedation or general anesthesia. The pretreatment hormonal profile, histology of testicular biopsies, and outcomes of TESE-ICSI in this subgroup of patients were analyzed. RESULTS: The mean patient age was 37.4 years (range, 28-54 years), and the mean follicle-stimulating hormone level was 21.8 mIU/mL (range, 7.1-43.1 mIU/mL). The mean age for female partners was 33.5 years (range, 22-43 years). Six patients had received chemotherapy for Hodgkin lymphoma (34%), four patients had received chemotherapy for testicular neoplasm (24%), two patients had received chemotherapy for non-Hodgkin lymphoma (12%), two patients had received chemotherapy for leukemia (12%), one patient had received chemotherapy for Wilms tumor (6%), one patient had received chemotherapy for mediastinal germ cell tumor (6%), and one patient had received chemotherapy for nephrotic syndrome (6%). Three patients (18%) received additional radiation therapy. The mean interval from chemotherapy to TESE was 16.3 years (range, 6-34 years). All patients had at least two semen analyses to confirm azoospermia. A total of 20 attempts of TESE-ICSI were performed (mean, 1.2 attempts per patient). Testicular histology revealed Sertoli cell-only pattern in 76% of patients. The remaining 24% of patients had hypospermatogenesis as their most advanced spermatogenic pattern. Among the men with Sertoli cell-only pattern, 23% had sperm retrieved by TESE. Sperm retrieval was accomplished in 9 of 20 attempts (45%), with biochemical pregnancy after sperm retrieval in 4 of 9 couples (45%) and clinical pregnancy in 3 of 9 couples (33%). Live deliveries were achieved in 2 of 9 couples (22%). Two healthy boys and one girl were delivered. No correlation was noted between the outcome of TESE-ICSI and the underlying conditions that were treated with chemotherapy nor with the chemotherapeutic agents used. CONCLUSIONS: Using TESE-ICSI, sperm retrieval leading to pregnancy and the delivery of healthy children is possible for men with long-standing azoospermia after chemotherapy. The prognosis for sperm retrieval was not influenced clearly by the chemotherapy regimen or the disease treated. Diagnostic biopsy also was of limited value in predicting the outcome of sperm retrieval. Despite prolonged nonobstructive azoospermia after undergoing chemotherapy, men no longer should be considered sterile in the era of advanced assisted reproductive techniques.
abstract_ja: 背景：化学療法後に長期間無精子症が続く男性は、一般に不妊と考えられてきた。著者らは、過去に様々な適応で化学療法を受けた無精子症男性に対し、精巣内精子採取(TESE)と顕微授精(ICSI)を併用した経験を報告する。方法：1995年から2000年に非閉塞性無精子症に対しTESE-ICSIを受けた198例・231周期のうち、以前に化学療法を受けた17例・20回のTESE手技を抽出した。全TESE手技は、顕微鏡下に局所麻酔下の鎮静または全身麻酔下で施行された。本サブグループの治療前ホルモンプロファイル、精巣生検の組織所見、TESE-ICSIの転帰を解析した。結果：平均年齢は37.4歳（範囲28～54歳）、平均卵胞刺激ホルモン値は21.8 mIU/mL（範囲7.1～43.1 mIU/mL）であった。女性パートナーの平均年齢は33.5歳（範囲22～43歳）であった。ホジキンリンパ腫に対して化学療法を受けた患者が6例(34%)、精巣腫瘍に対して受けた患者が4例(24%)、非ホジキンリンパ腫が2例(12%)、白血病が2例(12%)、Wilms腫瘍が1例(6%)、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍が1例(6%)、ネフローゼ症候群が1例(6%)であった。3例(18%)は追加の放射線療法を受けていた。化学療法からTESEまでの平均期間は16.3年（範囲6～34年）であった。全患者が無精子症を確認するため少なくとも2回の精液検査を受けた。計20回のTESE-ICSIが施行された（患者あたり平均1.2回）。精巣組織学では76%の患者がSertoli細胞のみパターンを示した。残りの24%は最も進んだ精子形成パターンとして精子形成低下を示した。Sertoli細胞のみパターンの患者のうち23%でTESEにより精子が回収された。精子回収は20回中9回（45%）で達成され、精子採取後の生化学的妊娠は9組中4組（45%）、臨床的妊娠は9組中3組（33%）であった。生児出産は9組中2組（22%）で得られ、健康な男児2名と女児1名が出生した。TESE-ICSIの転帰と、化学療法の対象疾患や使用薬剤との間に相関は認められなかった。結論：TESE-ICSIにより、化学療法後に長期間無精子症が続く男性においても、精子回収による妊娠と健康な子の出産が可能である。精子回収の予後は化学療法レジメンや対象疾患に明らかには影響されなかった。診断的生検は精子回収の転帰予測において限られた価値しかなかった。長期にわたる非閉塞性無精子症が化学療法後に続いても、高度生殖補助技術の時代において、男性はもはや不妊と考えるべきではない。
